verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an AI coding tool, and Cline runs its own provider and account service, but no evidence documents choosing a storage region or residency for Cline-held data. Running local models, self-hosting, and bringing your own API keys are adjacent controls over which model provider is used, not a residency feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
